metadata.title: Endpoint Lifecycle

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability governing how endpoints enter, transition within, reset, and exit institutional trust.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Endpoint and user-operated compute technology domain.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Endpoint provisioning, reset, rebuild, and retirement platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Managed endpoint lifecycle with explicit trust entry, transition, reset, and exit points.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Endpoint lifecycle state, ownership history, recovery events, and disposition records.

metadata.remarks:
Endpoint Lifecycle defines the capability to deliberately manage endpoint trust over time. It governs how endpoints are introduced into institutional trust, how trust is preserved or reset during ownership and role changes, and how trust is explicitly terminated. Proper lifecycle management ensures that software, credentials, and access do not persist beyond their intended trust boundaries.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to endpoint lifecycle and trust transitions. Configuration enforcement, health evaluation, and threat detection are intentionally excluded.

components.title: Initial Provisioning
components.description: Introduction of new endpoints into institutional management and baseline trust.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized addition of devices or identities during provisioning.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controlled and auditable provisioning of endpoint assets.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Create and manage endpoint identity records during initial provisioning.

components.title: Ownership and Role Transition
components.description: Controlled reassignment of endpoints between users, roles, or operational purposes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Residual access through endpoints not properly re-associated after role changes.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit reassignment and revalidation of endpoint trust during transitions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Update endpoint ownership, associations, and access during reassignment.

components.title: Trust Reset and Recovery
components.description: Reset and restoration of endpoint trust following compromise, misuse, or suspected integrity loss.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence via manipulation of endpoint state after compromise.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Re-establishment of endpoint trust through rebuild or validated recovery.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Restore endpoint integrity and trust following incident or compromise.

components.title: Retirement and Disposition
components.description: Permanent removal of endpoints from institutional trust and eradication of residual access and software.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence through devices that are improperly retired or sanitized.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Secure removal of endpoints from service and institutional trust.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Remove retired endpoints from institutional inventory.
Sanitize endpoint storage media prior to disposal or reuse.
